decision: order of work: Gate 0 (reproduce the driver foundation), then where the short exposure is on the wire, then whether PSYS completes a two-input graph, then the three build units
why: the kickoff fixes this order, riskiest unknown first, and nothing is built on an unproven step

decision: built the sensor module from branch head ca44c97 against the booted 7.3.1 kernel with the driver owner's recipe
why: Gate 0 needs the committed driver on the real sensor
result: built, same store path the driver owner tested

decision: first module swap left the camera not enumerating: the stock in-tree intel_ipu7_isys failed its probe with error -12
why: isys_fw_log_init asks for a 2 MB devm buffer, which is one 4 MB contiguous block, and both the Normal and DMA32 zones had none free at that moment. The machine has 9 GB free but vm.compaction_proactiveness is 0 and uptime is 3 days 16 h. The new sensor module itself bound fine

decision: the failed probe also printed a kernel WARN, not an oops
why: the probe error path removes its PM QoS request and drops the runtime PM reference, then the queued runtime suspend runs isys_runtime_pm_suspend on the same isys struct while the driver core frees it. The WARN is the QoS update on the removed request. The suspend also writes isys->power in that window, so a write after free cannot be ruled out. No Oops or BUG line in the kernel log since
evidence: /tmp/camre/work-dol/incident-dmesg.txt line 115; ipu7-isys.c isys_probe out_cleanup and isys_runtime_pm_suspend; kernel/power/qos.c:301
result: stock driver bug in a failure path, reachable on every ISYS reload when no 4 MB block is free

decision: reloaded the stock sensor module and ISYS, started v4l2-relayd-sc200pc, read 60 frames from /dev/video32
why: the kickoff says restore what you can when the camera stops enumerating
evidence: srcversion 74CDD8570FE991AF3052D64; kernel log 317815 to 317900 in incident-dmesg.txt; v4l2-ctl --stream-count=60 on /dev/video32 returned 60 frames 1920x1080 NV12; pgrep shows no capture process

decision: stopped before running the Gate 0 probe, no experiment run and no code changed
why: the kickoff names the camera not enumerating as a stop condition. Every later step needs more ISYS reloads, free 4 MB blocks swung between 0 and 91 within minutes (0, 91, 21, 37, 38, 10), and the two clean fixes are outside what I was allowed: compacting memory through /proc/sys/vm, or rebuilding ISYS
evidence: /proc/buddyinfo samples in this run; kickoff rules for sudo and for ISYS rebuilds
result: Gate 0 NOT VERIFIED (not run), unknowns 1 and 2 not started

decision: left a guarded swap script for whoever continues: it refuses to unload below 8 free 4 MB blocks and waits for them again right before loading ISYS
why: the check sits milliseconds before the allocation, so the failing probe path is nearly unreachable, and when blocks never appear ISYS stays unloaded without running the racy error path
result: only its check mode and bash -n were run, no real swap
